newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fraser sees medium term rates-budget link.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fraser sees medium term rates-budget link.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Bernie Fraser said on Thursday that reductions in the budget deficit had implications for interest rates in the medium term and that he saw the long term risk premium for Australia falling.
"Reducing the budget deficit has implications for interest rates, but in the medium term," Fraser told a parliamentary committee.
Fraser said that if the budget deficit reduction was sustained and that was reflected in higher national savings then Australia's risk premium would fall.
"If all those things happen the risk premium that is in long term interest rates in Australia will come down," he said.
